vectors.name: open-hello
vectors.notes: Minimal open-mode vector: 4 096 eligible pixels, so the stream is the whole capacity (512 bytes, m = N, width 1). Anyone with the spec can read it.

vectors.name: open-textured
vectors.notes: 262 144 eligible pixels, a 2 100-byte stream, sub-matrix width 10; the public permutation key.
vectors.plaintext_utf8: open mode on a textured carrier: a 2 100-byte stream of which 9 + 48 bytes are the frame

vectors.name: stealth-hello
vectors.notes: 16 384 eligible pixels: just under the 16 800 that give a full 2 100-byte stream, so S = 2 048 bytes and m = N. Every pixel is flat, so the encoder changes about half of them.

vectors.name: stealth-textured
vectors.notes: The common case: a 2 100-byte stream in 262 144 eligible pixels, width 10, HILL costs placing the changes in texture.
